Scatterplots

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
?mpg
```

```{r}
print(mpg)
```

To draw a scatterplot with a linear model excluding the standard error for highway miles per gallon and the engine displacement in litres where highway miles per gallon is less than 35

```{r}
mpg %>% 
  filter(hwy < 35) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(displ,hwy))+
  geom_point(aes(color = drv))+
  geom_smooth(method = lm,se = F)+
  labs(title = " Scatterplot for Engine Displacement aganist Highway miles per gallon")+
  theme_bw()
```
